title: Third Marineland beluga dies after being moved, this time in Spain
summary: A third beluga that was a part of a massive move of whales from Marineland has died, following two whale deaths in Chicago.

image.caption: A beluga whale is transported by a group of experts from Marineland and U.S. aquariums onto a truck via a sling at Marineland in Niagara Falls, Ont., on Wednesday, Aug. 12, 2026. (Carlos Osorio/The Canadian Press)

blocks.text: A third beluga that was a part of a massive move of whales from Marineland has died, following two whale deaths in Chicago.
Oceanografic Valencia says Jelly Bean died suddenly on Friday
A third beluga that was a part of a massive move of whales from Marineland has died.
Oceanografic Valencia says Jelly Bean died suddenly on Friday.
The Spanish aquarium took in Jelly Bean and another beluga named Cleopatra in late August.
Two Marineland belugas and a resident beluga at Chicago's Shedd Aquarium died within weeks of their move.

items: Another beluga whale sent from Marineland to Chicago's Shedd Aquarium has died

blocks.text: Marineland said it was running out of money and needed the whales gone otherwise they would be euthanized.
The closed Niagara Falls, Ont., tourist attraction moved all 30 of its belugas and four dolphins to five aquariums in Chicago, San Antonio, San Diego, Atlanta and Valencia in Spain.
